name: Airtel Niger Zinder data center phase
notes: Telecompaper reported Airtel Niger's USD 5.7m Zinder-Maimoujia fiber deployment would proceed in phases: a 12 km urban network in Zinder, construction of a data center in the city, and a 123 km link to Maimoujia at the Nigeria border. TechAfrica News corroborates the date, developer, cost, route, and strategic Zinder interconnection role, though it does not separately mention the data center phase. No MW capacity found.

name: Niger national Tier III data center, PK5 Niamey
developer: Government of Niger / Ministry of Communication and New Information Technologies; financed by African Development Bank Group
notes: National data center under the Trans-Sahara Optical Fibre Backbone Project. ANP reported on 2025-02-27 that the Tier III national data center was under construction with AfDB support, 13% complete, cost over 9bn CFA, and expected receipt by 2025-09-30. AfDB's 2025-11-21 release lists installation of a Tier III national data centre as a core component and says an 88 km Niamey urban loop will connect administrative sites to the future national data centre. BNEE EIES identifies the project location as PK5, Arrondissement Communal II, Niamey. No MW capacity found.
